title: Inventory list: remove duplicate title wrapper, restore out-of-stock badge
goal: The live /inventory page drifted from design/screens/08-inventory-list.html: the filter bar sat inside an extra Card with a duplicate 'Inventory' title (MobileTopBar already shows it once), and out-of-stock rows rendered a blank Sparkline instead of a status badge.
in_scope: Unwrap the filter bar's Card so FilterBarWeb/FilterTriggerMobile sit directly on the page background, matching the reference
Out-of-stock item rows show a Badge tone="error" ("Out of stock") as the trailing element instead of an always-rendered blank Sparkline
Reduce item-row meta to two facts (qty, cadence) instead of three, matching the reference's density
out_of_scope: Any change to the E-16 IA decision (5-item mobile tab bar, Today's extra quick-links) — confirmed intentional, not part of this audit
acceptance: app/(app)/inventory/page.tsx's filter bar no longer wraps in an extra Card with a duplicate 'Inventory' title/description. Out-of-stock item rows show a Badge tone="error" ("Out of stock") as the trailing element instead of an always-rendered blank Sparkline. The extra third meta line on item rows is removed.
invariants: No regression to existing inventory filtering/sorting behavior
